nodes.label: Parallel Workflow Diagram
nodes.description: SVG diagram depicting a parallel workflow pattern with 6 nodes (0-5). Node 0 fans out to nodes 1, 2, and 3 via success edges (green). Each of those nodes then connects to a downstream node via failure edges (blue): 1->4, 2->5, 3->5. Nodes 0,1,2,3 are filled (active/job nodes), nodes 4 and 5 are unfilled (terminal/handler nodes). Includes a legend showing Success (green), Failure (blue), and Always (yellow) edge types.

nodes.label: Workflow Node 0 (Root)
nodes.description: Root node of the parallel workflow that fans out to three parallel branches on success

nodes.label: Workflow Node 1 (Branch A)
nodes.description: First parallel branch node triggered on success of node 0

nodes.label: Workflow Node 2 (Branch B)
nodes.description: Second parallel branch node triggered on success of node 0

nodes.label: Workflow Node 3 (Branch C)
nodes.description: Third parallel branch node triggered on success of node 0

nodes.label: Workflow Node 4 (Failure Handler A)
nodes.description: Failure handler node for branch A (node 1), shown as unfilled circle

nodes.label: Workflow Node 5 (Convergence/Failure Handler)
nodes.description: Convergence node that receives failure edges from both node 2 and node 3, shown as unfilled circle. Appears twice in the diagram at bottom-center and bottom-right positions.

nodes.label: Parallel Workflow Pattern
nodes.description: A workflow pattern where a root node fans out to multiple parallel branches on success, each branch having its own failure handler. Demonstrates AWX workflow job template parallel execution with convergence.

nodes.label: Workflow Edge Types
nodes.description: Three types of workflow edges: Success (green, triggers on job success), Failure (blue, triggers on job failure), Always (yellow, triggers regardless of outcome)
